decisions.reason: Because the XL anamnesis package was launched in 2023 but disappeared from the website by 2024, management would read this as results falling below aspiration for a niche extension and reallocate resources to stronger digital workflow products.

The dental-assistant support service was visible in 2023 but no longer promoted in 2024, suggesting demand did not justify continued standalone commitment relative to the firm's aspiration levels and available alternative uses of service capacity.

The materials management module is a fresh 2024 extension close to the core software offer, and with industry growth and organisational slack the firm would keep it on the market while learning whether it can reach aspiration.

The secure healthcare messaging service was newly introduced in 2024 with its own page and clear link to regulatory digital-health updates, so management would keep backing it as a strategically important product whose performance is still too early to judge harshly.
